bug_semantics: getFilenameFromUrl treats a textual publicPath prefix as containment. With a non-slash-terminated publicPath such as /assets, /assets../.env passes pathname.startsWith('/assets'). The 2024 UP_PATH_REGEXP guard tests path.normalize('./' + pathname), where the only '..' is embedded in the segment 'assets..' and therefore is not rejected. Slicing at publicPathPathname.length then changes the same characters into the standalone relative path '../.env'; path.join(outputPath, '../.env') escapes one directory above outputPath. The escaped file is disclosed when the selected outputFileSystem exposes physical files (not the default isolated memfs), notably writeToDisk === true or a supplied filesystem. URL parsing/normalization limits this particular bypass to one parent level; publicPath 'auto' maps to '/' and is not affected.
flaw_origin: This case is the incomplete fix for CVE-2024-29180, not the older unrestricted traversal itself. The original character-prefix/slice pathname construction predates 2024, but the new vulnerable security design—a decoded pathname, segment-only UP_PATH_REGEXP check, startsWith containment, and fixed-offset slice—first appears in e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e on 2024-03-19. Its immediate parent is vulnerable to CVE-2024-29180 but does not contain this guard-and-bypass state, so it is outside the new advisory's post-fix affected range. Independent branch equivalents 9670b3495da518fe667ff3428c5e4cb9f2f3d353 (6.x) and 189c4ac7d2344ec132a4689e74dc837ec5be0132 (5.x) landed the next day; e10008c is the earliest and smallest public BIC.

BIC: `git show --format=fuller --patch e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e -- src/utils/getFilenameFromUrl.js` shows parent ab533de933c6684218172b86992f35c3ca6c58a4 and adds decoding before containment, `UP_PATH_REGEXP = /(?:^|[\\/])\.\.(?:[\\/]|$)/`, the guard over `path.normalize(\`./${pathname}\`)`, and `path.join(outputPath, pathname.slice(publicPathPathname.length))`. That exact protected-but-bypassable construction is the root of this incomplete-fix advisory.

reasoning: CVE-2026-76844 is specifically the post-CVE-2024-29180 incomplete-fix state. The older resolver was already traversable, but e10008c is the first commit to claim containment by decoding and rejecting standalone '..' segments while retaining a character-prefix startsWith test and an offset slice. Those operations are inconsistent: '/assets../.env' has no standalone traversal segment until slicing turns the suffix into '../.env'. The immediate parent lacks that security design and belongs to the predecessor advisory; the two next-day commits are equivalent backports to other release lines, not an earlier origin. No later commit or release in the frozen clone closes the bypass. The BIC commit object is human-authored and contains no AI disclosure or AI/bot identity, so the result is NOT_AI; later fix/refactor authorship is irrelevant under the BIC-only rule.
